8.7.6. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.ObjectIter¶

class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.ObjectIter(path, types=None)¶

An iterable over all objects in a path that are of given types.

Subclasses may override cond to implement other specific conditions for the objects returned.

Methods

__init__(path[, types]) Constructor.
cond(inIndex, obj, outIndex) This function determines if the type of an object is in types.
